entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello? I... I hope I can get some help. I need to make a return.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Isaac. I can certainly look into a return for you. Could you please provide me with your order number?
Yes, it's VF886-01. I just feel awful about this. I've been a customer for so long, and I've never returned anything before.

I appreciate your loyalty, and please don't worry, we're here to help. I see the order here for the AeroFlow helmet. Just to make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with it? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's not broken or anything. The box is unopened, actually. It’s just… the color. My daughter said it looks terrible, and I really value her opinion. I was so excited, but now I just feel sad looking at it. I was hoping I could get the money back.

I completely understand. Getting the right color is important, and it can definitely affect how you feel about your gear. And of course, the primary purpose of a helmet is safety, but you should also feel confident wearing it.
Exactly. I just... I really needed this money, and I feel like I made a mistake. I hope it's not too late.

Let me check the purchase date and our policy for you right now. One moment... Okay, I see it was delivered 36 days ago. For a standard item like this helmet, our policy allows for returns within 90 days.
Oh, really? So I'm still within the window? That's a huge relief.

Yes, you absolutely are. Since it's well within the 90-day period and you've confirmed the box is unopened, I can approve this return for a full refund immediately. I'm emailing you a pre-paid shipping label as we speak.
Wow. Thank you so much, Isaac. You have no idea how much better that makes me feel. I really appreciate it.
You are very welcome. I'm glad I could resolve this for you. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that was everything. Thank you again.
My pleasure. Have a great rest of your day, and thank you for being a VeloFit customer.
